methods.name: Poisson / negative binomial exposure regression
methods.assay: General count model; scATAC application proposed
methods.inputs: Raw regional counts, per-cell exposure, matched regions, cluster covariate, callable span
methods.outputs: Relative rate ratios, uncertainty and predictive zero rates
methods.mechanism: log mean = log exposure + region effect + covariates; NB dispersion accommodates extra-Poisson variability
methods.reference_requirements: Relative controls; no assumed diploid reference; absolute CN needs independent anchor
methods.low_coverage_handling: Zeros are measured counts; estimate predictive zero fraction conditional on exposure
methods.evidence: Count-model reference supported in scRNA; scATAC transfer unvalidated
methods.fit: Raw layer available; units, controls and independence need audit
limitations: Accessibility, mappability and CN are confounded
Cluster is coverage-confounded and adjustment may remove signal
Segments selected using same data create selection bias
uncertain: Region-specific dispersion and controls not yet evaluated

implementation.compute_notes: Small region-level fits are feasible in principle; no implementation or benchmark run.

methods.name: Phase-aware beta-binomial allele model
methods.assay: Numbat published for scRNA; proposed transfer to scATAC
methods.inputs: Phased allele observations and total allele counts, phase-set confidence, bias controls
methods.outputs: Haplotype fraction with interval and power against a specified imbalance; no allele data means no inference
methods.mechanism: Beta-binomial for counts given total with overdispersion; phase-switch error and heterogeneous mixtures require explicit modeling
methods.reference_requirements: No normal assumption for relative imbalance; calibrated baseline and SNP ascertainment remain necessary
methods.low_coverage_handling: AT=0 gives no allele-fraction information; finite counts yield wide uncertainty
methods.homozygous_deletion: Cannot identify 0:0 from allele fraction without independent dosage evidence

evidence.original_review: Numbat evaluated on scRNA; scATAC transfer untested
evidence.coordinator_update: Numbat-multiome 2025 provides scATAC evaluation of the joint model family; a new regional test on this dataset remains exploratory.

methods.fit: HA/HB/AT present but phase orientation, count units and SNP selection not verified
limitations: Overdispersion may be unidentifiable at sparse coverage
AT and raw depth may share fragments
uncertain: Observed per-region power and phase-set validity unknown

implementation.compute_notes: Small region-level fits are feasible in principle; no implementation or benchmark run.

methods.name: Hurdle, zero-inflated NB or latent count mixtures
methods.inputs: Same raw-count inputs and fitted baseline; technical controls and replicated datasets
methods.outputs: Predictive distribution and latent mixture uncertainty, not biological deletion classification
methods.mechanism: Separate probability of zero or mixture component; assess held-out predictions and model-based calibration
methods.reference_requirements: Component labels need external biological validation and identifiability
methods.low_coverage_handling: Extra zeros depend on the null model; small means and heterogeneity can mimic a zero component
methods.homozygous_deletion: A zero component is not proof of biallelic loss
methods.evidence: Zero-inflation evidence shown in scRNA; mixture asymptotic issues general
methods.fit: Consider only after baseline checks identify systematic misfit
limitations: Boundary and unidentified parameters invalidate naive chi-square LRT
uncertain: Bootstrap calibration and stability under model misspecification remain untested

implementation.compute_notes: Small region-level fits are feasible in principle; no implementation or benchmark run.

recommendations: Start with exposure-adjusted count predictive checks and a phase-aware allele power analysis.
Use zero-inflated or mixture models only as exploratory alternatives when held-out diagnostics motivate them.
uncertain: Numerical region-specific power, independent allelic trials and phase continuity remain unestablished. Descriptive regional counts and density contrasts were summarized in pilot.md.
No structural-zero model or independent CN truth was evaluated; model designs are not implementation or reuse decisions.
